name: review_request
description: Protected, two-step. Ask the Aminia Review Panel to review a decision the caller disagrees with (free, within 30 days, answered within 10 working days). Their reasons are stored as their words.

decision_id.description: decision_id from this call. Leave it out on a later call: the caller's newest decided decision in the open service is used.

grounds.description: Why the caller disagrees, in their words

confirmation_id.description: Empty the first time; after the caller says yes, the confirmation_id you were given
